title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About Voltus
Voltus represents the "potential of us" to better manage energy through simple, cost and risk-free demand response programs. Our commercial and industrial customers generate cash by allowing us to maximize the value of their operational flexibility in energy markets. We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

The Role
The Voltus Customer Success Associate ensures customers enter the market efficiently and ready to perform successfully to earn money. You will be a critical team member throughout the customer’s journey at Voltus, managing new and existing customer onboarding from start to finish and providing ongoing account support. You will be the primary point of contact for our customers throughout their onboarding journey and will partner with our Sales,Operations, and Energy Markets teams to deliver the best possible experience to our customers. You will drive adoption and expectations at the beginning stage of the customer journey. You will schedule and lead business meetings with our internal teams and customers and effectively communicate the onboarding status to avoid any delays and ensure seamless internal handoff to drive efficient onboarding. You will continue to support our customers and sales teams beyond onboarding with account related questions and provide the best customer experience.

title: Director of Product Marketing
description:
Voltus is the leading DER technology platform and virtual power plant operator connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. Our commercial and industrial customers and DER partners generate cash by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources in these markets.
Position Description
Voltus is seeking a Director of Product Marketing to own product-market fit for our platform. You'll sit close to the product organization, help shape our roadmap, and bring customer and market insight directly into product decisions. You'll own positioning and lead features from idea through launch, focusing on major product launches rather than day-to-day campaign execution.
You'll start as an individual contributor with the opportunity to build and lead a small product marketing team as the function grows.
The ideal candidate has deep experience in the energy space, ideally B2B, and has marketed to a broad, non-technical buyer base similar to our commercial and industrial customers. You're comfortable getting into the details with product and engineering, and just as skilled at translating that complexity into language a broad, non-expert audience can understand. You use AI tools to extend your own output and move faster.

title: Director of Product, Customer Experience
description:
About Voltus
Voltus is the leading platform connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. Our commercial and industrial customers and grid services partners generate cash by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources in these markets.

At Voltus, we live by the mantra "doing well by doing good" — and that includes actively doing our best by our team, clients, and partners.

Role Overview
Voltus is seeking an exceptional Director of Product Management to lead the team that owns the core customer-facing aspects of our platform. Reporting to the VP of Product & Design, you will lead critical product areas including customer dispatch, customer performance, market settlement, customer hardware and metering data, and the overall customer financial experience — all of which are essential to driving trust, value, and retention for customers.

As Voltus scales into new resource types, customer segments, and markets, this is the role that turns our market-leading position into a market-leading customer experience — one that lets customers self-serve, understand their economics, and earn more value per MW under management. Success means helping customers win because we've made it easy for them to perform.

This is a high-ownership leadership role with the opportunity to define bold strategy, build and scale a high-performing PM team, and apply deep product expertise to some of the most complex, commercially meaningful problems in energy. It's also a player-coach role: you will coach and develop the PMs on your team while staying hands-on, driving delivery for core features yourself. You and your team will partner closely with our market platform PM team, engineering, design, energy markets, and commercial leadership to deliver intuitive, scalable solutions that make it easier for customers to participate in (and profit from) electricity markets.

Voltus is a fully remote company. Candidates must reside and be authorized to work in the United States or Canada, aligned to a US time zone.

title: Energy Markets Intern (MISO)
description:
About Voltus
Voltus represents the “potential of us” to better manage energy through simple, cost- and risk-free demand response programs. Our commercial and industrial customers generate cash by allowing us to maximize the value of their operational flexibility in energy markets. We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good, and who have a genuine passion for delivering a cleaner energy future and for doing their best work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.

The Role
This is not a general energy internship. You’ll join the Energy Markets team responsible for how Voltus positions and sells the capacity generated by its demand response portfolio across wholesale markets. These are high-stakes, high-consequence positions, and sharper quantification of risk directly improves the quality of the decisions we make.

Your mandate is to make those decisions sharper and more defensible. You’ll build the quantitative tooling and models that let us price the risk of any market decision and value it on a risk-weighted basis. You’ll help integrate this logic into our living data model.

If you’re energized by energy markets (especially capacity markets), probabilistic modeling, and trading risk, and you want to own a problem where your analysis directly shapes real market positioning decisions, read on.

title: Hardware Production Technician
description: Voltus is seeking a hands-on, detail-oriented Hardware Production Technician to join our Hardware Production team within Field Operations. This onsite role combines hardware assembly, testing, troubleshooting, quality control, and order fulfillment. The ideal candidate is dependable, self-directed, analytical, and takes ownership of producing accurate, high-quality work.

title: Market Operations Analyst
description:
The Role
Voltus is hiring a driven Market Operations Analyst with a relentless drive to make us more efficient and execute on our promises to both our internal and external customers. You take pride in figuring out new ways to do something better, you get into the weeds, and you can’t help but measure and track everything you do so that you know how much better you do it the second and third time around. By the fourth time, you’ve automated it. You have relentless attention to detail, are a master project manager, and are intellectually curious about energy markets and demand-side resources. You are bright, gritty, and good, and you want to work with others like you.

title: Marketing Manager - Demand Gen & Field Marketing
description:
Company Description
Voltus is the leading DER technology platform and virtual power plant operator connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. Our commercial and industrial customers and DER partners generate cash by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources in these markets.
Position Description
Voltus has an immediate opening for a Marketing Manager - Demand Generation & Field Marketing. This role will own end-to-end demand generation strategy and execution for select territories across the US and Canada, from building and running the campaigns that drive pipeline to bringing that messaging to life through email, webinars, trade shows, and in-person events. Reporting directly to the Associate Director of Marketing, this role will be focused on helping Sales meet their annual, regional, and win rate goals.
This person will act as a true thought-partner to Sales and Energy Markets, not just a support function. Success in this role means becoming deeply embedded in these teams' day-to-day work: understanding their pipeline, their territory dynamics, and where deals are getting won or lost, closely enough to proactively surface more leads, help move deals across the finish line, and anticipate what Sales will need next before they have to ask.
The ideal candidate is action-oriented with a go-getter mindset, learns quickly, and can ramp on a new customer, product, and market fast. You'll own demand generation strategy while contributing across broader marketing priorities. Direct energy-sector experience is not required, but a background in B2B marketing at established, complex organizations is a strong plus.

title: Product Marketing Manager – Market Products
description:
Voltus is the leading platform connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. Our commercial and industrial customers, along with our residential and grid services partners generate cash by allowing Voltus to maximize the value of their flexible load, distributed generation, energy storage, energy efficiency, and electric vehicle resources in these markets. Our aspiration is to be a leader in increasing diversity within the energy industry, and that starts with a commitment to diversity, equity and inclusion within our organization.
We are seeking a Product Marketing Manager to own the positioning, messaging, and market-facing enablement for our Commercial & Industrial (C&I) distributed energy solutions. Example products in this solution set include: our emergency load response program (ELRP) offering in PJM, and our LMR offering in MISO.  Sitting at the intersection of product, sales, and energy market dynamics, you will translate complex, market-connected Distributed Energy Resource (DER) offerings into clear, high-converting narratives that drive customer understanding, acquisition and retention.

title: Sales Associate (Remote)
description:

Voltus is the leading platform connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets, delivering less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. title: Sales Director PJM
description:
Voltus builds power capacity at scale. We provide reliable, clean capacity alongside traditional power plants in wholesale electricity markets. As load growth accelerates, the grid is confronting structural constraints. Speed-to-power and affordability are no longer secondary considerations; they are foundational to economic growth.
Voltus enables faster, cleaner, lower-cost capacity by optimizing existing infrastructure rather than waiting years for new generation to come online. Our sales team builds the customer relationships that make this possible, working directly with the facilities, manufacturers, and institutions whose participation adds capacity to the grid.

title: Sales Productivity Specialist
description:
Voltus is growing rapidly, and we see Sales Productivity as a critical role to capitalize on that growth. We are looking for someone to proactively partner with sales leaders and their teams to drive efficiency and productivity in both day-to-day and strategic tasks. The primary purpose of this role is to act as the leading edge of growth across the sales organization by maximizing sales team productivity at scale. We do this through innovative solutioning, best-in-class activation, strategic thought partnership, and consistent high standards of execution. This is a fully remote position that offers a high degree of autonomy.
We're looking for people who don't just execute on a project, but who define and own it independently, and who bring new ideas rather than replicate what's already been done. This team is meant to be an innovation engine for Sales, and we want people who think that way.

title: Sales Training & Enablement Senior Manager / Director
description:
About Voltus
Voltus is the leading DER technology platform and virtual power plant operator, connecting distributed energy resources to electricity markets to deliver less expensive, more reliable, and more sustainable electricity. We hire teammates who are bright, gritty, and good, with a genuine passion for a cleaner energy future.

title: Senior Salesforce Administrator
description:
Voltus is hiring a Sr. Salesforce Administrator to help drive the productivity and operational effectiveness of our Go-to-Market organization. Reporting to the Director of Sales Operations, you'll take ownership of Salesforce administration end-to-end — from hands-on configuration to system governance — while partnering closely with our current administrator and with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Customer Success stakeholders.
This is a high-visibility role for someone who wants to bring deep Salesforce expertise to a mission-driven clean energy company. We're looking for someone who is not just a power user, but a strategic thinker who can translate business needs into scalable Salesforce solutions.
Voltus is a remote and virtual company, distributed across US, Canada, and abroad. Candidates must be authorized to work in the US or Canada.

title: Senior Software Engineer, Infrastructure
description:
About Us
Our mission is to be the Distributed Energy Platform that fulfills the promise of the energy transition. The Voltus platform connects any distributed energy resource (DER) to any energy market across the US and Canada, providing flexibility, reliability, and resilience to the grid while generating revenue for our partners. By partnering with industry leaders and the DER ecosystem, we are building the decarbonized, distributed, decentralized, and digitized energy system of the future.
Voltus is a remote and virtual company, distributed across the US, Canada, and abroad, with team members in New York, San Francisco, Boston, Toronto, Chicago, Los Angeles, Washington DC, and many other cities.
About the Role
Are you interested in building the technical foundation of the worldwide transition to clean energy? Do you enjoy working with a highly motivated and talented team to deliver mission critical software?
Voltus is growing our Infrastructure team to help deploy, manage, troubleshoot, and enhance the Platform and tooling that every Voltus engineer and our dispatch-critical systems depend on. As a Senior Software Engineer on Infrastructure, you will own significant pieces of our core Platform, mentor other engineers, and help set the technical direction for how we build, deploy, and operate services at Voltus. You will join a team of 7 engineers supporting roughly 60 engineers across the org, so the leverage on your work is high and so is the responsibility.
Our Platform runs on HashiCorp's Nomad, Consul, and Vault in AWS. We are specifically looking for someone who brings deep Kubernetes experience to this team, because we expect to run Kubernetes workloads alongside Nomad and that is depth we do not have in house today. You will not be the only person who knows containers, but you may well be the one who knows Kubernetes best, and we want you to shape how we adopt and operate it.
You will develop the tooling that lets every engineering team ship reliably, build the testing and observability that keeps our real-time systems healthy, and help shape how we safely fold AI-assisted development and tooling into our day-to-day engineering.
When Voltus commits capacity to a grid operator, we are obligated to deliver it. That shapes how this team works: changes are planned around live dispatch windows, sequenced so each step can be rolled back, and owned by the person who made them, including on call.
Voltus is a fully distributed company and this role is remote. You can work from anywhere, but you must overlap with the Eastern time zone for at least 4 hours of the workday.

title: Sr. Director of Revenue Operations
description:
About the Role
Voltus is building its Revenue Operations function from the ground up, and this role owns that build.
As we enter a hyper-growth phase, the components of revenue operations exist in pieces across the company: reporting handled by one team, forecasting by another, productivity tracked separately within Sales. What's missing is a single owner connecting the full customer journey, from outreach through close through renewal, into one trustworthy source of truth that Sales, Finance, Energy Markets, and our Customer Org can all rely on.
This role differs from a typical RevOps seat in one key way: Voltus doesn't invoice customers directly for fixed contract value. Revenue depends on whether enrolled customers are nominated, enrolled, and actually perform in market events. As a result, forecasting and reporting here means connecting committed contract value to realized, performance-based revenue, a more complex and consequential problem than most revenue operations roles are built to solve.
This role reports to our Senior Director of Sales Enablement, sits within the Sales organization, and carries the mandate to influence how the broader company understands and acts on revenue data.

title: Supply & Logistics Coordinator
description:
The Role
Voltus is seeking an organized and proactive Supply & Logistics Coordinator to join our Hardware Production team within Field Operations. This onsite role combines purchasing, inventory management, shipping, and hands-on warehouse responsibilities. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, self-directed, and able to manage multiple priorities while keeping materials and hardware moving efficiently.

title: Technical Recruiter
description:
About the Role
Voltus is hiring a Technical Recruiter to own full-cycle recruiting for our Engineering and Product teams. This is a builder's role: you'll partner directly with engineering leadership to define hiring needs, build sourcing pipelines from scratch, and run a rigorous, fast-moving interview process. We're not looking for someone who waits for inbound applicants to come to us. We need someone who goes and finds the right people.
You'll work closely with our VP of Engineering and engineering leadership to fill roles ranging from generalist backend engineers to highly specialized positions in optimization and control systems, and you'll help us build a stronger, more diverse pipeline as we scale.
